content.description: Installation diagram showing drive motor location and clearance positions A and B between sliding roof and body

items: (a) Move the sliding roof by hand so the clearance between the left and right of the sliding roof and body are equal.
(b) Install the drive motor into the roof.
(c) Install the center cover of control box.

content.text: TO REMOVE ONLY SLIDING ROOF PANEL

items: (a) Pull loose the clips and slide the headlining rearward.
(b) Remove the front and rear shoe bolts.
